Cytolume — local Human Reference Atlas snapshot

Captured: 2026-10-18T01:10:35.831Z

Component: HuBMAP HRA UI, Copyright (c) 2023 HuBMAP Consortium, MIT.
Source: https://github.com/hubmapconsortium/hra-ui
Upstream and patched component bytes are both included. The only patch changes the
API base URL to the local static adapter. Full component and dependency licenses
are in licenses/hra-ui-MIT.txt and licenses/third-party.txt.

Anatomical models and scene data: Human Reference Atlas / HuBMAP, CC BY 4.0.
https://humanatlas.io/3d-reference-library
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
Full license: licenses/CC-BY-4.0.txt

Model geometry is unchanged. Scene data is restricted to the reference organs used
by this demo, tissue-block cuboids are omitted, and model URLs are made local.
Each original metadata file in metadata/ preserves that object's creators, DOI,
license and provenance. snapshot.json records source URLs, versions and SHA-256.

The demo's cell-type-to-organ assignments are SYNTHETIC, not biological evidence.
